Title: REQ-001: Register with a valid email
Preconditions: User is not registered; registration page is open
Steps:
1. Enter a valid, unused email address
2. Enter a password that meets the password policy
3. Submit the registration form
Expected Result: Account is created, a success message is shown, and the user can sign in with the new credentials

Title: REQ-001: Reject a malformed email
Preconditions: Registration page is open
Steps:
1. Enter 'user@@example' in the email field
2. Enter a valid password
3. Submit the form
Expected Result: A validation error is shown on the email field and no account is created

Title: REQ-001: Reject an already registered email
Preconditions: An account exists for test@example.com
Steps:
1. Enter test@example.com in the email field
2. Enter a valid password
3. Submit the form
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a clear message and no duplicate account is created

Title: REQ-001: Reject a password that breaks the policy
Preconditions: Registration page is open
Steps:
1. Enter a valid unused email
2. Enter a password shorter than the minimum length
3. Submit the form
Expected Result: A validation error describes the password rule and no account is created

Title: REQ-001: Registration fields reject script injection
Preconditions: Registration page is open
Steps:
1. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in each text field
2. Submit the form
Expected Result: Input is rejected or escaped, no script runs, and nothing unsafe is stored or echoed back

Title: REQ-001: Registration validation messages are visible and labelled
Preconditions: Registration page is open
Steps:
1. Submit the form with every field empty
2. Review the error messages
Expected Result: Each error appears next to its field, is readable, and names the field and the problem

Title: REQ-002: Sign in with Google
Preconditions: User has a Google account; login page is open
Steps:
1. Click 'Sign in with Google'
2. Choose the Google account and grant consent
Expected Result: User is redirected back and signed in; the profile shows the Google account email

Title: REQ-002: Sign in with Apple ID
Preconditions: User has an Apple ID; login page is open
Steps:
1. Click 'Sign in with Apple'
2. Authenticate with the Apple ID and grant consent
Expected Result: User is redirected back and signed in; a profile exists for the Apple identity

Title: REQ-002: Cancel consent on the OAuth screen
Preconditions: Login page is open
Steps:
1. Click 'Sign in with Google'
2. Click Cancel on the consent screen
Expected Result: User returns to the login page with a message and no session is created

Title: REQ-002: Reject an OAuth callback with a tampered state value
Preconditions: OAuth sign-in is started and the callback URL is captured
Steps:
1. Change the 'state' parameter in the callback URL
2. Open the modified URL
Expected Result: The callback is rejected, no session is created, and the failure is logged

Title: REQ-003: Order history lists past orders in sequence
Preconditions: User is signed in and has at least 3 completed orders
Steps:
1. Open the profile page
2. Open the order history section
Expected Result: All orders are listed in a consistent date order, each with date, items and total

Title: REQ-003: Order history for a user with no orders
Preconditions: User is signed in and has no orders
Steps:
1. Open the profile page
2. Open the order history section
Expected Result: An empty-state message is shown and there is no error

Title: REQ-003: A user cannot view another user's order history
Preconditions: Users A and B are signed in on separate sessions; user B has orders
Steps: 1. As user A, request the order history URL or ID that belongs to user B
Expected Result: Access is denied (403 or 404) and no data about user B is returned

Title: REQ-004: Product page shows image and localized price
Preconditions: A product with an image and a price exists
Steps:
1. Open the product page
2. Check the image and the price
Expected Result: A high-quality image loads and the price uses the correct currency symbol and format for the locale

Title: REQ-004: Price format follows the selected locale
Preconditions: Store supports at least two locales
Steps:
1. Open a product page in locale A
2. Switch to locale B
3. Compare the price display
Expected Result: Currency symbol, separators and position change to match locale B

Title: REQ-004: Product without an image shows a placeholder
Preconditions: A product exists with no image asset
Steps:
1. Open the catalog listing
2. Open the product page
Expected Result: A placeholder image is shown and the layout does not break

Title: REQ-005: Filter by category and rating
Preconditions: Catalog has products in several categories and ratings
Steps:
1. Open the catalog
2. Select one category
3. Select a minimum rating
Expected Result: Only products matching both filters are listed and the result count updates

Title: REQ-005: Filters that match nothing
Preconditions: Catalog is loaded
Steps: 1. Select a category and a rating combination with no products
Expected Result: A 'no results' message is shown with an option to clear filters

Title: REQ-006: Typeahead suggests products while typing
Preconditions: Catalog contains products starting with 'sho'
Steps:
1. Click the search box
2. Type 'sho' slowly
Expected Result: A suggestion list appears without a page reload and updates as characters are typed

Title: REQ-006: Suggestion endpoint returns matches
Preconditions: The suggestion endpoint is reachable
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to the suggestion endpoint with the partial query 'sho'
2. Read the response
Expected Result: Status is 200 and the body is a list of suggestions that match the query

Title: REQ-006: Typeahead with an empty or special-character query
Preconditions: Catalog is loaded
Steps:
1. Focus the search box and type only spaces
2. Clear it and type '%$#&'
Expected Result: No error is shown, no broken suggestion list appears, and the page stays usable

Title: REQ-006: Search input is protected against injection
Preconditions: Catalog is loaded
Steps:
1. Type <script>alert(1)</script> in the search box
2. Type ' OR 1=1 -- in the search box
Expected Result: Input is escaped, no script runs, and the results are not altered by the injected text

Title: REQ-007: Quantity change updates totals without a refresh
Preconditions: Cart contains one item
Steps:
1. Change the item quantity from 1 to 3
2. Watch the line total and the cart total
Expected Result: Line total and cart total update immediately and the page does not reload

Title: REQ-007: Reject a negative quantity
Preconditions: Cart contains one item
Steps:
1. Enter -2 as the quantity
2. Confirm the change
Expected Result: The value is rejected with a message and the previous quantity and totals remain

Title: REQ-007: Quantity above available stock
Preconditions: A product has 5 units in stock; it is in the cart
Steps: 1. Set the quantity to 6
Expected Result: A stock message is shown and the quantity is limited to 5 or rejected

Title: REQ-008: Flat tax and shipping are calculated automatically
Preconditions: Cart contains items; shipping address is in a supported region
Steps:
1. Enter the shipping address
2. Choose a shipping method
3. Review the order summary
Expected Result: Tax is a flat rate for the region, shipping is added, and the total equals subtotal + tax + shipping

Title: REQ-008: Address outside the supported region
Preconditions: Cart contains items
Steps:
1. Enter a shipping address in an unsupported country
2. Continue to the next checkout step
Expected Result: A clear 'delivery not available' message is shown and checkout does not continue

Title: REQ-009: Guest completes checkout without an account
Preconditions: User is not signed in; cart contains items
Steps:
1. Start checkout as a guest
2. Enter contact and shipping details
3. Enter payment details and place the order
Expected Result: Order is placed, a confirmation with an order number is shown, and no account is required

Title: REQ-009: Guest checkout with missing required fields
Preconditions: User is not signed in; cart contains items
Steps:
1. Start checkout as a guest
2. Leave required fields empty
3. Try to continue
Expected Result: Each missing field is highlighted with a message and the order is not placed

Title: REQ-010: Pay by card using Stripe
Preconditions: Cart contains items; Stripe test mode is on
Steps:
1. Enter the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with a future expiry and any CVC
2. Place the order
Expected Result: Payment succeeds, the order is confirmed, and the payment is recorded as paid

Title: REQ-010: Card number is never sent to the merchant server
Preconditions: Browser developer tools network tab is open
Steps:
1. Enter card details and place the order
2. Inspect the requests sent to the merchant server
Expected Result: Only a Stripe token is sent to the merchant server; the card number and CVC are absent

Title: REQ-010: Create a payment with a valid token
Preconditions: A valid Stripe token has been created
Steps:
1. Send the token to the merchant's payment endpoint with the order id
2. Read the response
Expected Result: Status is 200, the response contains the payment status, and the order is marked paid

Title: REQ-010: Declined card
Preconditions: Stripe test mode is on
Steps:
1. Enter the test card 4000 0000 0000 0002
2. Place the order
Expected Result: A decline message is shown, no order is confirmed, and the user can try another card

Title: REQ-010: Reuse of a payment token is rejected
Preconditions: A payment token has already been used for a successful payment
Steps: 1. Send the same token to the payment endpoint again
Expected Result: The request is rejected, no second charge is created, and the error is logged

Title: REQ-010: Pay with PayPal
Preconditions: Cart contains items; PayPal sandbox account is available
Steps:
1. Choose PayPal at checkout
2. Sign in to the sandbox account and approve the payment
Expected Result: User returns to the store, the order is confirmed, and the payment is recorded

Title: REQ-010: Cancel the PayPal payment
Preconditions: Cart contains items; PayPal sandbox account is available
Steps:
1. Choose PayPal at checkout
2. Click Cancel on the PayPal page
Expected Result: User returns to checkout with the cart intact and no order or charge is created

Title: REQ-011: Site accepts TLS 1.3 connections
Preconditions: A TLS testing tool is available
Steps:
1. Connect to the site using TLS 1.3
2. Check the negotiated protocol
Expected Result: The handshake succeeds with TLS 1.3 and the certificate is valid

Title: REQ-011: Older TLS versions are refused
Preconditions: A TLS testing tool is available
Steps: 1. Try to connect using TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1
Expected Result: Both connections are refused

Title: REQ-011: Plain HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS
Preconditions: The site is reachable over HTTP
Steps: 1. Open the http:// address of the login page
Expected Result: The browser is redirected to the https:// address and no content is served over HTTP

Title: NFR-001: Key pages respond within 2.0 seconds
Preconditions: Standard broadband network profile is set in the test tool
Steps:
1. Load the home, catalog, product and cart pages 20 times each
2. Record the time to the key interaction frame
Expected Result: The 95th percentile for every page is 2.0 seconds or less

Title: NFR-001: Checkout steps respond within 2.0 seconds
Preconditions: Cart contains items; standard broadband profile is set
Steps:
1. Move through each checkout step
2. Record the response time of each step
Expected Result: Each step responds within 2.0 seconds

Title: NFR-002: System handles 10,000 simultaneous sessions
Preconditions: A load-test environment matches production
Steps:
1. Ramp up to 10,000 virtual users browsing and adding to cart
2. Hold the load for 30 minutes
3. Record error rate and response times
Expected Result: No crashes, error rate stays under the agreed limit, and NFR-001 response times still hold

Title: NFR-002: Behaviour beyond 10,000 sessions
Preconditions: A load-test environment matches production
Steps:
1. Ramp up to 12,000 virtual users
2. Observe errors and recovery after the load is removed
Expected Result: The system degrades gracefully, does not lose orders, and recovers without a manual restart

Title: NFR-003: All checkout controls work by keyboard only
Preconditions: Checkout page is open; mouse is not used
Steps:
1. Press Tab to move through every control
2. Use Enter or Space to activate each one
3. Complete checkout
Expected Result: Every control is reachable, the focus indicator is visible, and checkout completes without a mouse

Title: NFR-003: Text colour contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA
Preconditions: Home, product and checkout pages are open
Steps: 1. Run a contrast checker on text and controls on each page
Expected Result: Normal text has a ratio of at least 4.5:1 and large text at least 3:1

Title: NFR-003: Form fields have labels for screen readers
Preconditions: A screen reader is running; registration and checkout forms are open
Steps: 1. Move through each form field with the screen reader
Expected Result: Each field is announced with its label, required state and any error message

Title: NFR-004: Layout adapts on a mobile width
Preconditions: Browser window is set to 375 px wide
Steps: 1. Open home, catalog, product, cart and checkout pages
Expected Result: Content fits the width, nothing is cut off, there is no horizontal scroll, and controls are tappable

Title: NFR-004: Layout adapts on tablet and desktop widths
Preconditions: Browser window is set to 768 px, then 1440 px
Steps: 1. Open home, catalog and product pages at each width
Expected Result: The layout uses the available space and keeps a consistent structure

Title: NFR-004: Resizing the window keeps the page usable
Preconditions: Any page is open on a desktop browser
Steps: 1. Drag the window width from 1440 px down to 320 px and back
Expected Result: The layout changes smoothly at each breakpoint and no content overlaps or disappears
